blind.B1: No for an exercise question on this series. GSE216094 is RNA-seq of primary iWAT adipocytes transduced in vitro with GFP or PSAP adenovirus (S5.1.3.p1, TAB1, S5.3.14, FIG5 G-H). Exercise appears only in the gastrocnemius EF proteomics (S2.2, PRIDE). No sequenced sample carries an exercise factor; at most an in-vitro 'exercise-mediator' (PSAP, found via PGC1a/cold) design.
blind.B2: PSAP pAd vs GFP pAd, n=4 vs 4 (FIG5 E-H legends; packet A metadata).
blind.B3: No repeated animal/person; separate cultures of pooled SVF-derived cells, no unit stated. Title-suffix key pairs 1-4 across arms but the expression check is not supported (r diff 0.41, p=0.075) and the paper does not say cultures are matched.
blind.B4: Paper does not say (only DESeq2 v1.22.1 via VIPER, S5.3.20.2.p1).
blind.B5: No DEG rule stated for RNA-seq (S5.3.20.2.p1). GSEA with TPM > 5 filter; Hallmark OXPHOS q < 0.001 (FIG5H). No DEG count. Proteomics rule q < 0.05 (S5.3.11.p1) does not apply.

checks.evidence: Refused at design; GEO has only GFP vs PSAP adenovirus in vitro; labelled as not exercise (S5.1.3.p1, FIG5).
grp GFP 4 / PSAP 4 from titles matches FIG5 n=4 and treatment column.
No documented repeated unit; candidate title-suffix key not supported by expression check; no analysis run.
One sex only noted; no run, no batch aliasing evident.
TPM matrix correctly identified (non-integer, STAR_Gene_TPM); paper used counts, recorded as discrepancy.
Records RNA-seq DEG threshold not stated; GSEA q<0.001; proteomics q<0.05 not applied.
No ours-vs-paper comparison claimed; HANDBACK states none computed.
Reason (no exercise arm in series) is true: GEO characteristics and paper agree; wide check (paper, GEO metadata, TAB1).

human_items: Open policy: whether an in-vitro exercise-mediator (PSAP overexpression) series should count as an exercise study; here it was refused and labelled.
summary: 该系列为体外原代iWAT脂肪细胞GFP与PSAP腺病毒转导(各n=4)的RNA-seq,没有运动组;运动实验是EF蛋白质组(PRIDE)。拒绝运行的理由成立且已如实标注,未发现需要修改的项目。仅有一个开放政策问题(体外运动介质设计是否算运动研究)留给人工。
